newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai PTT tender to buy Oct fuel oil valid to Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Thai PTT tender to buy Oct fuel oil valid to Thurs.

text.p: A buy tender for 78,000 tonnes of October fuel oil by State-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) closes on Wednesday, traders said.
PTT issued the tender on Monday to buy 70,000 tonnes of 2.0-percent fuel oil and 8,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent fuel oil for delivery between October 26-30 to Sri Racha.
The tender is due to be awarded on Thursday.
Last month, PTT purchased 70,000 tonnes of 2.0-percent sulphur fuel oil at more than $9 per tonne over Singapore quotes for deliveries in the first half of September.
It also purchased 10,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur fuel oil at $16 per tonne over Singapore quotes for first half September.
